blocks.text: Now that Rabin Angeles and Angela Muji have wrapped up the finale episode of their Viva One series “Dating Alys Perez,” things are coming up roses for the onscreen sweethearts. The 16-episode “Dating Alys Perez” (DAP) is the sequel to the hugely popular series adaptation of “Seducing Drake Palma” with Angeles and Muji — dubbed RabGel by fans — playing the lead roles.
